title: Jet vs Missile
one_line: Fly a stealth jet through the sky while launchers on the ground fire ever-smarter homing missiles at you.
how_to_play: Computer: WASD to fly (let go and the autopilot keeps flying), mouse to aim, click or Space to fire, E shield, C camouflage, F flares, T triple jet, N/P or the level strip to change level.
description: Six mobile launchers on the ground fire homing missiles that climb, turn and chase your jet. Missiles grow from short range to hypersonic as the levels rise, carry more ammunition (scatter, flak, homing micro-missiles) and learn tactics like dodging your shots, flanking and jamming. Every 5 levels both sides get faster and stronger. Launchers take two hits to destroy; a shot-down jet falls burning to the ground. Levels 1 to 100 plus endless overdrive, and a 2-player jet vs missile duel.
